es: Mantener una conversación delicada con un compañero de piso: pedir un cambio con tacto, discrepar con matizadores y cerrar un acuerdo explícito.

teaching.en: I was wondering if we could change the cleaning schedule.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podríamos cambiar el horario de limpieza.
teaching.explanationEs: Pasado tentativo: pides un cambio sin exigirlo.
teaching.audioText: I was wondering if we could change the cleaning schedule.

teaching.en: Wouldn't it be fair if we split the bills equally?
teaching.es: ¿No sería justo que dividiéramos las facturas a partes iguales?
teaching.explanationEs: Pregunta negativa + if + pasado simple: propones algo con tacto. Lleva it.
teaching.audioText: Wouldn't it be fair if we split the bills equally?

teaching.en: I don't want you to get upset, but I'd say the flat gets a bit noisy at night.
teaching.es: No quiero que te molestes, pero yo diría que el piso se pone un poco ruidoso por la noche.
teaching.explanationEs: Matizadores (I'd say, a bit) para decir algo incómodo sin ofender.
segments: I don't want you to get upset, but I'd
say the flat gets a bit noisy at night.
teaching.audioText: I don't want you to get upset, but I'd say the flat gets a bit noisy at night.

teaching.en: That seems fair, but I'm afraid Mondays are difficult for me.
teaching.es: Me parece justo, pero me temo que los lunes me vienen mal.
teaching.explanationEs: Concesión + I'm afraid: aceptas lo razonable y discrepas con tu motivo.
segments: That seems fair, but I'm afraid
teaching.audioText: That seems fair, but I'm afraid Mondays are difficult for me.

teaching.en: So we have a deal: you cook on Fridays and I clean on Sundays.
teaching.es: Entonces tenemos un trato: tú cocinas los viernes y yo limpio los domingos.
teaching.explanationEs: Acuerdo explícito: quién, qué y cuándo.
segments: So we have a deal: you cook
on Fridays and I clean on Sundays.
teaching.audioText: So we have a deal: you cook on Fridays and I clean on Sundays.

teaching.en: We agreed to take turns with the shopping.
teaching.explanationEs: agreed to + verbo base: confirma lo que se decidió entre todos.
teaching.audioText: We agreed to take turns with the shopping.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase pide un cambio con un pasado tentativo?

choices.text: I hope we change the bills day.
I was hoping we could change the bills day.

feedback.es: I was hoping we could… es el pasado tentativo: pide el cambio sin exigirlo.

hint.es: Busca hoping o wondering en pasado, seguido de could.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿No sería mejor que cocináramos por turnos?»

feedback.es: En inglés la pregunta negativa lleva sujeto: wouldn't it be…?; en español no se dice.

hint.es: En español el sujeto se omite; en inglés hace falta.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige en qué acuerdan Mia y Leo.

choices.text: Leo pays a smaller part of the rent.
They move to a bigger flat.

feedback.es: Mia propone dividir el alquiler por tamaño, Leo concede y pide una parte menor, y cierran con «we have a deal».

origin.audio: Mia: Wouldn't it be fair if we split the rent by room size? Leo: I see your point, but I'm afraid my room is a bit small. How about a smaller share for me? Mia: That sounds fair. So we have a deal.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta discrepa con tacto y propone una solución?

choices.text: No, that is not fair. You must help me.
I see your point, but I'm afraid that's a bit hard for me. Wouldn't it be fair if we took turns?
Perhaps. I will think about it, I'm afraid.

feedback.es: Concede, suaviza con I'm afraid y propone turnos; las otras dos acusan o dejan la conversación en el aire.

origin.text: Tu compañero de piso propone que limpies tú solo. No estás de acuerdo.

prompt.es: Escribe tu parte de la conversación sobre la música por la noche (60 a 110 palabras).

answer.text: Hi Sam, I was wondering if we could talk about the music at night. I'm afraid I get up very early, and the flat seems a bit loud after ten. Wouldn't it be better if you turned the music down after ten? I see your point about Fridays, though, so maybe you could play it louder then. So we have a deal: quiet after ten on weekdays, and music on Fridays until eleven. Thanks for understanding.
accepted: Hi Sam, I was wondering if we could talk about the music at night. I'm afraid I get up very early, and the flat seems a bit loud after ten. Wouldn't it be better if you turned the music down after ten? I see your point about Fridays, though, so maybe you could play it louder then. So we have a deal: quiet after ten on weekdays, and music on Fridays until eleven. Thanks for understanding.

Hi Sam, I was hoping we could talk about the music. I'm afraid it is a bit hard for me to sleep, because I start work early. Couldn't you use headphones after ten? I understand that Fridays are different, and I'm not sure I need quiet that night. So we agreed: headphones on weekdays, and normal music on Fridays. Thanks, that sounds fair to me.

feedback.es: El mensaje pide un cambio con tacto, discrepa con matizadores y concesión, y cierra con un acuerdo explícito.

origin.text: Conflicto de convivencia: tu compañero de piso escucha música alta por la noche y tú tienes que madrugar. Escribe tu parte: pide un cambio con una pregunta negativa o un pasado tentativo, discrepa con tacto y cierra con un acuerdo explícito.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase es un pasado tentativo para pedir un favor?

choices.text: I hope you can water the plants.
I hoped you water the plants.
I was hoping you could water the plants.

feedback.es: I was hoping you could… aleja la petición con un pasado y un modal; las otras dos usan el presente o una forma incorrecta.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué responde Ana.

choices.text: She needs time and has doubts.

feedback.es: «Interesting, but it might be tricky» y «let me think about it» expresan duda y piden tiempo.

origin.audio: Leo: Wouldn't it be better if we cooked on different days? Ana: Well, that's interesting, but it might be tricky. Let me think about it.

feedback.es: I'm afraid + oración con a bit: rechazo cortés con matizadores.
